runbooks.trigger: Booking in PendingApproval longer than 6 h (warning) or 24 h (critical).
steps: Confirm admin notification email delivery (outbox + SMTP logs).
Open admin bookings queue filtered to PendingApproval.
Prioritize review of flagged booking(s); approve or decline with reason.
If queue is empty but alert persists, check BookingStatusAudit vs current status for stale data.

runbooks.trigger: Pending cancellation request auto-declines within 30 minutes.
steps: Surface the booking in the admin cancellation queue immediately.
Approve or decline deliberately before AutoDeclineAtUtc.
If unreachable, note auto-decline will restore booking to Confirmed and email the client.

runbooks.trigger: Cancelled booking with Payment.Status = Approved (refund owed) older than 24 h (warning) or 72 h (critical).
steps: Reconcile manual transfer logs (Vodafone Cash / InstaPay).
Record refund via POST /api/v1/admin/payments/{id}/refunds/record when transfer completed.
Escalate if client contact is needed or amount is disputed.

runbooks.trigger: Background job last success older than 2× (warning) or 4× (critical) its configured interval.
steps: Verify app process health and that BackgroundJobs:Enabled is true.
Inspect JobRunHistory for the named job (LastSuccessAtUtc, LastFailureAtUtc, LastError).
Check application logs around the last failure; restart the app if the worker loop stopped.
After recovery, confirm the next heartbeat updates LastSuccessAtUtc.

runbooks.trigger: Job recorded LastFailureAtUtc newer than LastSuccessAtUtc.
steps: Read LastError in JobRunHistory for the job name.
Fix root cause (DB, storage, email provider, code defect).
Wait for the next scheduled run or restart the app; confirm success heartbeat.
Inspect LastError, MessageType, and AggregateId for the message.
Fix template, recipient, or provider configuration.
Requeue via explicit operator action (manual resend / new outbox row per runbook in spec 01).
Treat as provider outage (SMTP, DNS, credentials).
Pause non-essential deploys; verify Email:* configuration and provider status.
Clear backlog incrementally after provider recovery; monitor for recurrence.
